Subject: Fokfu / ฟ็อกซ์ฟู: brave FIRE attack fox. Coral-orange fox with huge triangular ears with cream inner fur, confident bright eyes, cream muzzle and chest, one enormous curved FLAME-shaped tail with golden yellow glowing tip. A small flame forelock curling between ears, flame-shaped cheek tufts. Compact agile body, tiny dark-brown paw boots; paws empty. Keep cute and friendly, strong orange-and-gold silhouette. This must read as a fiery fox, not a generic cat.

Subject: Bubblebun / บับเบิลบัน: WATER guardian rabbit. Round aquamarine rabbit with two long drooping ears shaped like flowing water ribbons, white fluffy belly, short plump legs, bright calm dark eyes. Wearing a tiny shell brooch and pale blue translucent bubble collar. Holds a single translucent circular bubble shield alongside one paw; bubble shield stays attached to the character silhouette. Huge lavender mushroom cap tilted sideways with pale mint swirled spots, the brim resembling a windswept hat.
